[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any two terms A and B, their third proportional is given directly by C = B² ÷ A.

Given B = x⁰.²⁵ × y⁰.²⁵ × z⁰.²⁵, so B² = x⁰.⁵ × y⁰.⁵ × z⁰.⁵.

Given A = x².⁵ × y−¹.⁵ × z³.⁵.

Divide B² by A to get C = x⁽⁰.⁵ − ².⁵⁾ × y⁽⁰.⁵ − ⁽−¹.⁵⁾⁾ × z⁽⁰.⁵ − ³.⁵⁾.

Simplifying the powers directly gives C = x−² × y² × z−³ = y² / (x²z³).

**∴ The correct answer is y² / (x²z³).**
